generator.name: Hackerbot 3 role-play lab tutor for a protecting integrity lab
generator.author: Z. Cliffe Schreuders
generator.description: Generates a config for a chat-only Hackerbot 3 bot that role-plays a member of teaching staff ("Sam", the lab tutor) for the protecting integrity lab. It runs no attacks, gives no flags and asks no quizzes: it explains concepts, helps students get unstuck and points them to the lab sheet. Common questions get instructor-written canned answers from the decision router (lab id staff_integrity_protection); anything else goes to the LLM with a staff-tutor system prompt. Run it alongside the hb3_integrity_protection attack bot.
